info.title: Klaviyo API (Beta)
info.description: The Klaviyo REST API. Please visit https://developers.klaviyo.com for more details.

get.description:
> 🚧 This endpoint is in beta and subject to change. > > A beta revision header (2026-10-15.pre) is required to use our beta APIs. Klaviyo APIs in beta are not intended for use in production. See our [versioning and deprecation policy](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/api_versioning_and_deprecation_policy) for more information. Get the in-person events in an account. Returns pop-ups, conferences, and other in-person events. Physical locations are a separate resource and are not returned here. Returns a maximum of 100 events per page (default 25), newest first unless another `sort` is requested.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `10/s`
Steady: `150/m` **Scopes:** `locations:read` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/beta/apis/get_location_live_events_beta.json)

post.description:
> 🚧 This endpoint is in beta and subject to change. > > A beta revision header (2026-10-15.pre) is required to use our beta APIs. Klaviyo APIs in beta are not intended for use in production. See our [versioning and deprecation policy](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/api_versioning_and_deprecation_policy) for more information. Create an in-person event. The event has to be placeable on a map: supply either `address1`, or both `city` and `region`, or both `latitude` and `longitude`. Klaviyo geocodes whatever is supplied and fills in the remaining address fields it can resolve, so `latitude` and `longitude` may be absent from the response until geocoding finishes — check `geocode_status`.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `10/s`
Steady: `150/m` **Scopes:** `locations:write` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/beta/apis/create_location_live_event_beta.json)

requestBody.description:
Request to create an in-person event.

An event must be placeable on a map, so the request has to carry either an address or a coordinate pair: a non-empty ``address1``, or both ``city`` and ``region``, or both ``latitude`` and ``longitude``. Whatever is supplied is geocoded, and the fields it can resolve are filled in on the created resource.

> 🚧 This endpoint is in beta and subject to change. > > A beta revision header (2026-10-15.pre) is required to use our beta APIs. Klaviyo APIs in beta are not intended for use in production. See our [versioning and deprecation policy](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/api_versioning_and_deprecation_policy) for more information. Get the segments linked to a location. A segment is linked to at most one physical location, so a location's segments are the ones that target it. Segment details are read from the segments service and cached for five minutes, so a segment renamed moments ago may still report its old name.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `10/s`
Steady: `150/m` **Scopes:** `locations:read` `segments:read` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/beta/apis/get_segment_ids_for_location_beta.json)

post.description:
> 🚧 This endpoint is in beta and subject to change. > > A beta revision header (2026-10-15.pre) is required to use our beta APIs. Klaviyo APIs in beta are not intended for use in production. See our [versioning and deprecation policy](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/api_versioning_and_deprecation_policy) for more information. Link existing segments to a location. Segments already linked to this location are left alone, so sending the same request twice changes nothing. A segment linked to a *different* location moves to this one. To create a new segment first, use `POST /api/segments`.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `3/s`
Steady: `60/m` **Scopes:** `locations:write` `segments:write` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/beta/apis/add_segments_to_location_beta.json)

requestBody.description:
A segment as a JSON:API resource identifier.

Written out rather than derived with ``TypeAndIdOnly`` because a dynamically built class can't be used as a type annotation.

> 🚧 This endpoint is in beta and subject to change. > > A beta revision header (2026-10-15.pre) is required to use our beta APIs. Klaviyo APIs in beta are not intended for use in production. See our [versioning and deprecation policy](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/api_versioning_and_deprecation_policy) for more information. Build a segment definition that targets profiles near a location. Nothing is created or stored. Pass the returned `name` and `definition` to `POST /api/segments`, then link the result with `POST /api/locations/{id}/relationships/segments`. The definition matches on the location's postal code and country, so a location missing either cannot produce one.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `10/s`
Steady: `150/m` **Scopes:** `locations:read` `segments:read` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/beta/apis/query_proximity_segment_definition_beta.json)

Klaviyo-API-Key.name: Authorization
Klaviyo-API-Key.description:
Private key authentication for /api/ endpoints is performed by setting the `Authorization` header to `Klaviyo-API-Key your-private-api-key`
For more information please visit https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/v2026-10-15.pre/reference/api-overview#authentication
